stories.title: Mulla demonstrated unmatched bravery during the 1971 sea war:INS Khukri’s crew saved under captain’s fearless leadership valor
stories.summary: The first week of December 1971 was among the most terrifying phases of the India–Pakistan war at sea. The Arabian Sea was in violent turmoil. To break the enemy’s hold in these hostile waters, INS Khukri was deployed. Commanding the warship was Captain Mahendra Nath Mulla, a native of Gorakhpur in Uttar Pradesh. INS Khukri was a Blackwood-class frigate built in Britain in the 1950s. Though it appeared formidable, the reality was different. During World War II, thousands of Indian soldiers had shed blood for Britain, creating a moral debt. Instead of repaying it with modern assets, Britain handed over outdated warships to India. Part of the Western Command’s 14th Squadron, INS Khukri, INS Kripan, and INS Kuthar were second-class anti-submarine frigates—vessels tasked solely with detecting and destroying enemy submarines hidden beneath the sea. The sonar system installed on Khukri was extremely weak, capable of detecting submarines only up to 2,500 meters. Pakistani vessels, by contrast, could track targets from nearly ten times that distance—around 25,000 meters. War with Pakistan had already broken out. India’s aging ships were now up against Pakistan’s modern French-built Daphne-class submarines, known for operating with near silence. These submarines were often described as “silent killers.” On the cold night of December 2, as the Indian fleet moved from Bombay toward Karachi, Pakistani submarines lay in ambush. During the operation, INS Kuthar developed a serious technical fault and became immobilized mid-sea. The message reached Captain Mahendra Nath Mulla. “INS Kuthar is not in a condition to move on its own. INS Kripan is towing her. You are responsible for keeping both ships under your protection and ensuring they reach Bombay safely. Over…!” Captain Mulla picked up the receiver and replied calmly, “Okay, we are providing cover. Over and out…” During the journey, Khukri’s alarms sounded several times, but each alert turned out to be false. Then came the afternoon of December 5. Suddenly, commotion erupted in the sonar room. A distinctive echo rang in the operator’s headphones—ping. He immediately reported, “Sir, contact… range 2,500 meters. This isn’t a fish. It’s definitely a submarine.” Captain Mulla’s nerves tightened. He thundered, “Put the entire ship on action stations. Signal Kripan not to change course. We will pursue this hunter.” Khukri turned sharply toward the threat. The sonar operator reported nervously, “Sir, it’s right around us.” Captain Mahendra raised his hand and ordered, “Now, fire…” A series of explosions shook the sea. Massive columns of water rose as high as the ship itself. The hull trembled violently. Moments later, recording instruments captured a horrifying grinding sound, as if something had snapped underwater. The sailors cheered, “We’ve destroyed it, sir… definite hit.” The First Officer asked softly, “Sir, should we stop and check? If we find oil slicks or debris, it will be confirmed.” Captain Mahendra glanced at his watch and pointed toward the two helpless ships struggling ahead. “No… our first responsibility is to bring Kuthar safely to Bombay. We cannot reveal our position by stopping here. Move ahead…” The next day, when the fleet reached Bombay, the crew of Khukri believed they had scored a victory. Captain Mahendra submitted his report at Western Naval Command. “Sir, we neutralized the enemy. We have recordings of the explosions.” A senior officer responded coldly, “Recordings are not enough, Captain. Where is the oil? Where is the debris? Without concrete proof, we cannot accept that a Pakistani submarine was sunk.” The Indian Navy was aware of the limitations of its sonar systems. A secret project was underway with the Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC) to upgrade outdated technology. Lieutenant V.K. Jain, a young and promising officer, was working relentlessly on the project. Though the results were encouraging, the research was incomplete. Still, it was decided to install the experimental T-170 sonar on INS Khukri for testing, which was expected to extend detection range from 2,500 to 25,000 meters. Around the same time, intelligence inputs indicated the presence of the Pakistani submarine PNS Hangor about 16 nautical miles (approximately 29 km) from Daman and Diu. Hangor’s air-conditioning system had failed around December 1, making life inside unbearable. Repairs required the submarine to surface. While informing Karachi of the malfunction, Hangor’s radio signals were intercepted by Indian Navy direction-finding systems. The enemy’s location was now clear. Orders were issued immediately: “Find the enemy and destroy it.” The task was assigned to F-14 Squadron commander Captain Mahendra Nath Mulla. However, INS Kuthar was already out of action. Only two ships remained—INS Khukri and INS Kripan. On December 8, both ships sailed out. Lieutenant Jain boarded Khukri to test the new sonar. The search began on the morning of December 9. From the wheelhouse, Captain Mahendra looked up at the sky and said, “Lieutenant Jain, I hope your new sonar doesn’t betray us.” Jain replied, “Sir, we’ve put everything into it. We just need one signal.” Unbeknownst to them, Hangor had already detected the Indian ships from a distance. Its commander briefly surfaced, assessed the situation through binoculars, and slipped back underwater. He identified the rectangular NATO search pattern and predicted where Khukri and Kripan would be next. Both Indian ships were in blackout mode—not even a candle was lit. They moved blindly into the trap. The new sonar required Khukri to slow down to 12 knots, limiting maneuverability. Captain Mahendra appeared visibly frustrated. At 8:30 pm, tension filled the wheelhouse. “Sharma, any update on the replacement of the seeking helicopters?” Captain asked sharply. “No sir, no signal yet. Our search area is completely empty,” Operations Officer Manu Sharma replied. Captain Mahendra said sternly, “Jain, because of your machine our speed is dropping. If we don’t move in a zig-zag pattern, we’ll be an easy target. And if we zig-zag at this speed, we’ll slow down so much that we ourselves will become prey.” Lieutenant Jain responded, “Sir, just give me one minute. I’ll explain the position on the chart.” At that moment, Hangor fired its first torpedo—targeting INS Kripan. The torpedo failed to explode, but Hangor’s position was exposed. The Pakistani commander chose to attack again. The second torpedo struck INS Khukri beneath the ammunition magazine. A deafening explosion ripped through the ship. Fire erupted. Steel tore apart like paper. The vessel tilted sharply. Captain Mahendra was thrown against a bulkhead, blood streaming from his forehead. “Sir, are you okay?” Lieutenant Kundan shouted. Captain roared, “Forget me—give me a report…!” Power failed. Darkness engulfed the ship. “Full ahead on both engines—now…!” Captain ordered. But communication with the engine room was lost. Khukri began sinking. Manu Sharma rushed to the deck and returned in shock. “Sir, the ship is sinking. We must abandon ship immediately.” With no broadcast system, Captain Mahendra shouted, “Shout it out—tell everyone to abandon ship and jump into the water!” Amid chaos, sailors struggled through narrow stairways, trapped by bulky life jackets. Captain Mahendra personally pulled them out. “Don’t push—one by one.” As icy seawater reached the wheelhouse, Lieutenant Kundan urged him, “Sir, it’s too late now. Please come…” Captain Mahendra looked at him calmly and said, “This is my final order—jump and save yourself…!” A captain’s order could not be ignored. Lieutenant Kundan jumped into the waves of the sea. After swimming some distance, he turned back and saw INS Khukri sinking rapidly. “Abandon ship, get into the water… this is my order!” Captain Mahendra Nath Mulla kept shouting. A sailor rushed forward with a life jacket. “Sir, please wear this.” Captain handed it to a frightened young sailor. “You wear it and jump.” He could have saved his own life, but instead, he gave his life jacket to a junior. The water was rising fast. Then the captain’s eyes fell on Lieutenant Basu. Placing a hand on his shoulder, he spoke with fatherly affection: “Son… don’t delay anymore. Get into the water immediately.” Tears welled up in Lieutenant Basu’s eyes as he jumped into the raging Arabian Sea. When he looked back, the captain was still there—standing as if he was not guarding a ship, but his honour. Operations Officer Manu Sharma, who had already entered the sea, saw that the captain was seated calmly on his chair, like a king on his throne. A lit cigarette was in his hand. He was completely composed, as if waiting for an old friend. At the front of the ship, a few sailors were still clinging to the railing. They were unwilling to leave their captain behind. Then a deep, groaning sound echoed—like a massive iron body writhing in pain. For centuries, the sea has followed an unwritten tradition: the captain never abandons a sinking ship. In 1912, Titanic’s Captain Edward Smith did the same—saving people till his last breath and going down with the ship. On INS Khukri, that tradition came alive once again. After the torpedo strike, Captain Mahendra Nath Mulla ensured that everyone else evacuated the ship. In his mind, there was only one thought—he could not abandon his fellow sailors. He chose the ship because it was not just metal and machinery. It was his responsibility, his honour, and his family. INS Khukri sank into the sea.But Captain Mahendra Nath Mulla’s courage became immortal—a living example of a tradition that never dies. At 8:45 pm on December 9, 1971, INS Khukri sank into the depths of the Arabian Sea with its brave captain and loyal sailors. The sea grew silent again—but a hero had fallen into the lap of Mother India. Captain Mahendra Nath Mulla was posthumously awarded the Mahavir Chakra. stories.title: Scuffle reported after attempt to enter Avimukteshwaranand’s camp:‘CM Yogi Zindabad’ slogans raised; disciples claim Shankaracharya’s life was in danger
stories.summary: A dispute has been continuing for the past six days between Avimukteshwaranand and the mela administration in Prayagraj. On Saturday night, a group of youths attempted to enter the Shankaracharya’s camp. They began raising slogans of “CM Yogi Zindabad”. During this, a scuffle broke out between the youths and Avimukteshwaranand’s disciples. Shankaracharya’s special representative, Devendra Pandey, said: “This is our compulsion because the Shankaracharya is sitting on the road. Here there is the administration and its goons. Devils are roaming here in the guise of saints. The Shankaracharya’s life is under threat from them. They come at night and make videos. When caught, they say they have come to serve a notice.” He added: The youths first tried to enter the Shankaracharya’s camp. After pushing and jostling with his disciples, they started raising slogans of ‘Yogi Zindabad’. Avimukteshwaranand’s health remains poor. On Friday, his condition deteriorated suddenly and he took medication after developing a high fever. Meanwhile, for the security of the camp, 12 CCTV cameras have been installed both inside and outside. On the controversy, Samajwadi Party president Akhilesh Yadav said the Shankaracharya had exposed “fake Sanatanis”. “We are happy that Avimukteshwaranand is standing firm. Every Sanatani is with him. He has at least exposed the fake Sanatanis. We are in direct contact with him,” Akhilesh said. Earlier on Friday, Avimukteshwaranand had described Deputy Chief Minister Keshav Maurya as a sensible leader. He said a person who understands that officials have made mistakes should be the Chief Minister, adding that someone who sits with arrogance should not hold the post. On Thursday, Deputy Chief Minister Keshav Maurya had said, “I bow at the feet of Shankaracharya ji and request him to take the holy dip.” Know what happened on Mauni Amavasya On January 18, during the Magh Mela on Mauni Amavasya, Avimukteshwaranand was going to bathe in a palanquin. The police stopped him and asked him to go on foot. When he protested, there was a scuffle with his disciples. Angered by this, Avimukteshwaranand sat on a dharna outside the camp. The administration issued two notices to Avimukteshwaranand within 48 hours. In the first notice, questions were asked about him using the title of Shankaracharya, while in the second notice, questions were asked about the commotion regarding Mauni Amavasya. The administration had warned, "Why shouldn't you be banned from the Magh Mela forever?" Avimukteshwaranand had sent replies to both notices.

stories.title: Boyfriend locked in box for 45 minutes in Kanpur:Girl seals him inside as aunt arrives; police intervene and rescue him
stories.summary: In Kanpur, a girl locked her boyfriend inside a box for 45 minutes when her aunt arrived home. The boyfriend had come to meet her. Suspicious, the aunt knocked on the door, prompting the girl to hide him in the box and lock it from the outside. When her mother and brother also arrived, they searched the room but heard movement in the box. The girl refused to give the key, and family members tried to break the lock. When that failed, they called the police. The police made the girl unlock the box, freeing the boyfriend. Both were taken to the police outpost. The incident occurred in the Chakeri police station area. Know the case details In a village under Chakeri police station, a girl was having an affair with a neighboring young man. On Friday morning, her elder brother went out on his tractor, and her mother left for work at the factory. Around 11:30 AM, the girl called her boyfriend home, and he arrived by bike. Meanwhile, the girl’s aunt, living nearby, came to the house and heard a boy’s voice from one of the rooms. She knocked on the door and called out, but the girl did not open it. The aunt then called her son, who also tried to get the door open, but the girl still refused. Boy locked in box in Kanpur The girl’s aunt locked the main gate from outside and called the girl’s brother and mother, saying, “There is a boy locked inside the house.” The brother arrived shortly and informed the police. The family knocked on the door, which the girl opened, but the boy was nowhere to be found. Soon, sounds came from a box. The family asked for the key, but the girl denied anyone was inside. When she refused, they tried breaking the lock. Around 12 PM, police arrived, reprimanded the girl, and she finally opened the box, freeing her boyfriend. Girl also handed over to the police

stories.title: UP Panchayat elections likely to be postponed:Wont take place in April-May, to happen after 2027 Assembly elections; reason - census
stories.summary: There is big development regarding the UP Panchayat elections. According to sources, it seems difficult to hold elections in April-May. These elections may only happen after the 2027 assembly elections. Actually, house listing work for Census-2027 will be done from April 1 to September 30. In this situation, the government and State Election Commission will not have sufficient staff and officers available to conduct panchayat elections. Similar indications are coming from the slow pace of government and political parties. The 16th census will be held in 2027 On January 22, the Office of Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India released the schedule for Census 2027. The 16th census will be held next year i.e. 2027. For the first time, it will be completely digital. 'House listing' will be done from April 1, 2026 to September 30, 2026. In the second phase, population counting will be done from February 1 to 28, 2027. In the census house listing, around 50 to 60 thousand teachers, Shiksha Mitras, and Lekhpals along with employees from other categories will be assigned duty across 75 districts of UP. District Magistrates, Chief Development Officers, SDMs, Tehsildars, Municipal Commissioners, Executive Officers, and Block Development Officers will be deployed for census work in the districts. SIR for Panchayat elections will be completed on March 27 Meanwhile, the voter list revision work for panchayat elections will also be completed on March 27. The final publication of voter lists will be done on the same day. The government and State Election Commission were preparing to conduct panchayat elections in April-May, but now the state's large administrative, teaching and employee staff will be engaged in house listing work for the census. In such a situation, it will not be possible to get sufficient staff for the panchayat elections. According to BJP sources, house listing work will begin by September, before which the party will start preparations for the 2027 assembly elections. In this situation, both the party and the Yogi government are not in favor of conducting panchayat elections after September. Government and Organization Also Don't Want Timely Elections According to BJP sources, both the party and government are not in favor of holding timely elections. There are several political risks in panchayat elections before the assembly elections. Firstly, political animosity between party workers will increase in villages. Secondly, disgruntled party workers who don't get candidate selection may take tickets from other parties and weaken the party. If the party's performance in the district panchayat member and area panchayat member elections is not good, it will directly affect the assembly elections. Even in 2021, the experience of the first phase of panchayat elections was not good for the Yogi government and BJP. A lot of effort had to be made to control its damage. According to sources, this issue was also discussed in the recent core group meeting of the party and government that the panchayat elections should be postponed until after the assembly elections. Panchayati Raj Department Not Ready The State Election Commission has written a letter to the Panchayati Raj Department to determine the reservation for panchayat elections and submit the list. The Panchayati Raj Department has to form a committee to determine the reservation. The committee will determine the reservation for 2026 based on the panchayat reservations of 2021 and 2015 The reservation determination process takes about two months. However, the department has not even started the process of forming the committee yet. Senior officials of the department have also indicated that there are currently no preparations for panchayat elections. No signals have been received from the high level in the government for this either. Message reaching the villages Public representatives associated with Panchayati Raj institutions are also saying that they have been indicated by the government and organization that elections will not be held for now. Panchayat elections will be conducted only after the assembly elections. Due to this, preparation for panchayat elections has almost stopped in the districts. BJP officials and workers are engaged in SIR and Jeeramji schemes instead of panchayat elections. Waiting for green signal from national leadership BJP official said they are waiting for green signal from national leadership regarding panchayat elections. If the national leadership deems it appropriate to hold elections on schedule, they will be conducted in April-May. If the state leadership of government and organization gets permission from central leadership to hold panchayat elections only after assembly elections, then elections will be postponed. Receivers will be appointed The term of village heads, area panchayat members and district panchayat members in the state will end in the first week of May. Meanwhile, the five-year term of block chiefs and district panchayat presidents will complete in the first week of July. In such a situation, if elections are not held on time, a competent officer will be appointed as receiver (administrator) by the government in place of village heads, block chiefs and district panchayat presidents. Now read what different people said about the election, State General Secretary and Panchayat Election In-charge Ram Pratap Singh said- When will panchayat elections be held, will they be held or not. No message has been received from the government regarding this. BJP is fully prepared for the panchayat elections. Additional Commissioner State Election Commission Akhilesh Mishra said- The commission is fully prepared for the panchayat elections, once the reservation is determined. After that, the election process will be started. The census will not make much difference, when elections happen those days employees will not do house listing. Director Panchayati Raj Amit Kumar Singh said- The process for determining reservation has not started yet, this proposal is at the government level. Whatever relevant action will be taken according to the rules will be done. There is no pending work related to panchayat elections at our level.

stories.title: Are we living on their mercy? asks Shankaracharya:Mocks Yogi, says, 'He is wearing a sadhu's dress but cow slaughter going on, you tell who is Kalnemi?'
stories.summary: Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand has been sitting on a protest at the Magh Mela for 6 days. Upset with the kind of the treatment that he has got from UP Govt, he says - Among Muslims, the religious leader is the Caliph (head of state). The Caliphate tradition is being brought into Hinduism. On the Kalnemi statement in Sanatan, Shankaracharya said, "The attire is of a sage but cow slaughter is happening. Now you tell me who is Kalnemi?" On the request to end Keshav Prasad Maurya's controversy, he says, "This statement reflects BJP's initial sentiment, but today's BJP is not acceptable to people." On Ganga bathing he says, "There is a tradition of bathing with respect, not a tradition of bathing with disrespect." When Rambhadracharya said - Administration did right by giving notice, Shankaracharya responded - Don't talk about him, he is maintaining friendships. Read the full interview... Question: Yogi says some people are weakening Sanatan, is he pointing towards you? Answer: Yes, some people are weakening Sanatan, this is absolutely true. In Sanatan, there was a tradition that the king and religious leader were separate. There were royal gurus, kings themselves were not gurus. This is a tradition in Muslims, they have the Caliphate tradition. This means that whoever is the head of the nation is also the religious leader. There is an attempt to bring the Caliphate tradition into Hinduism. The one who is king is also the guru. Those who are bringing the Caliphate tradition into Hinduism are the ones weakening Hindu religion. Question: Yogi mentioned Kalnemi, who is destroying dharma? Answer: Brother, who is Kalnemi? Kalnemi was a demon who appeared as a sage. What did the demon do - he would kill Brahmins, humans, and cows while wearing the garb of a sage. Look here, the garb is of a sage but cow slaughter is happening. Now you tell me who is Kalnemi, please tell. Question: Did Keshav Maurya tell you to take a bath and end the matter? Answer: This is that BJP which came initially saying they would work for Hindus. Keshav Prasad Maurya has demonstrated that original spirit of BJP, which I welcome. This is the BJP that people had embraced. This new BJP that has emerged now says we will do whatever we want, no matter what anyone says, we won't listen. This version of BJP is not acceptable to people. Question: You first denied Mauni's snan, then Basant's, what next? Answer: On Mauni Amavasya day, when we left our camp in the morning, we left with the intention that we would go to Sangam and take a bath there. We were going the same way as we had been going in previous years. Then we were obstructed from snan at Sangam, indecency and offenses were committed. Until there is a clear word of apology, until it is clear that such incidents will not happen in the future, what is the point of taking a snan. Tulsidas had said- Gods, demons, celestial beings and humans all. Respectfully get snan in the Triveni. There is a tradition of having holy dip with respect, there is no tradition of bathing with disrespect. Question: The saint community is divided into two parts, some are speaking in your favor, some in favor of the government? Answer: This is a style of politics, where whichever side has more people prevails. This style doesn't work among saints and holy men. Here it's not about how many saints are with whom. In politics, they look at how many votes one has. In our domain, we look at who is speaking in accordance with the scriptures. This is not politics. Here, crowds don't matter. Question: Why are you considering the Magh Mela incident as an insult? Answer: During the Mughal period, when this Magh Mela was happening, a Jaziya tax was imposed here. Only those Hindus who paid the tax were allowed to take snan. At that time, the neighboring Peshwas were ruling, they went to Shankaracharya saying, "Please come Maharaj, this is very wrong." Then Shankaracharya came, without caring for his life. He had snan with the Hindus. He said, "If anyone has the courage, come forward, we are here to take snan." Seeing them, people started coming and this is the situation today. Since then, Shankaracharyas have made rules for having holy dip, because Shankaracharya established this tradition over many years. The Shankaracharya who gave us the opportunity to snan, today if you people insult them, how can this be accepted. Question: Administration will take back land and facilities, what do you say? Answer: Are we living on their pieces? If they don't provide facilities, will we not live? Is the Shankaracharya of 100 crore Sanatani people dependent on them that we need administration to give us something to carry on our work? Let them take whatever they want to take, but they don't have the right to insult us. They don't... they don't. Question: Rambhadracharya ji said that it was right to give you notice? Answer: Don't talk about him, he is maintaining friendship. People don't take him seriously. Because he says anything. Look, saints and batuks were beaten here and he speaks such language. This means he has more sympathy with politicians. He is not from our lineage. If he was from our lineage, he would have felt our pain. Question: Did Rambhadracharya say that one should not travel by palanquin? Answer: The public themselves have slapped him. His videos are floating on the internet, where he himself went to the banks of Ganges in a luxury car and took a dip there. The public has given Rambhadracharya a strong slap. What can he say to us? As far as the palanquin is concerned, even the Peshwas used to have our palanquin carried. Naga sadhus used to carry our palanquin. Now we have come. We have already done the last 2 Magh snans with the palanquin. Question: What is the controversy about Shankaracharya's position, what's the status in court? Answer: There is no controversy. People are just trying to show that there is a controversy. Put a piece of gold in front and say that I don't consider you gold. What difference will it make to the gold? If you don't believe it, test me on a touchstone, or cut me with a cutter and look inside, or heat me in a furnace and see. Therefore, raising these controversies doesn't achieve anything, what is, will remain as it is. If an owl says it's dark and the sun hasn't risen, does that mean the sun hasn't actually risen? What kind of logic is that? Question: Shankaracharyas select Shankaracharya, if court's decision comes against, then what will you do? Answer: Why would it come against us, will the court act arbitrarily? The court will not decide who is Shankaracharya. Know this, just because there is a case in court doesn't mean they will make any decision. The court will only see that there are 2 parties, 1 party is saying I am Shankaracharya. The other is saying I am Shankaracharya. The court will see whose process is correct. Whoever is correct will be told yes. Whoever is not will be told no. Our process is completely correct, so the court cannot do anything arbitrary. Now know what happened during the bath time of Mauni Amavasya... On January 18, Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand was going to have holy dip in a palanquin during Mauni Amavasya at the Magh Mela. The police stopped Shankaracharya Swami Avimukteshwaranand's palanquin. The police asked him to walk to Sangam. Shankaracharya's disciples did not agree and started moving forward with the palanquin. This led to pushing and shoving between the disciples and the police. Police had taken several disciples into custody. The police had also beaten a sadhu at the police post. This angered Shankaracharya and he insisted on getting his disciples released. Officials tried to reason with him, folded their hands, but he did not agree. After this, the police took several more supporters of Shankaracharya into custody. Shankaracharya's palanquin was dragged 1 km away from Sangam. During this, the canopy of the palanquin also broke. Shankaracharya could not even take snan. Since then, he has been sitting on a dharna at the banks of Sangam.

stories.title: BSP under scrutiny as 2 criminals meet Mayawati, join party:One faces 56 cases, second is a known history-sheeter; leaders distance themselves
stories.summary: The Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) has landed in controversy after allegations surfaced that criminals were inducted into the party in an attempt to expand its base. Shockingly, two alleged criminals were even made to meet BSP chief Mayawati in person and were formally inducted by being made to wear the party scarf. Both individuals reportedly wanted to contest the upcoming three-tier panchayat elections as authorised BSP candidates for the post of district panchayat member. However, soon after their induction, murmurs about their criminal backgrounds began circulating within the party. When senior BSP leaders became aware of their past, panic set in. To avoid displeasure from Mayawati, party leaders began distancing themselves from the matter. As of now, the entry of both has been stopped. First case registered in 2007 Meeting with Mayawati in Lucknow on January 22 Role of Meerut coordinator Vikram Singh Mayawati’s tough stance on criminals BSP chief Mayawati is widely known for her strict stand against criminals. During her tenure as Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister from 2007 to 2012, she showed zero tolerance toward professional criminals. A notable example is that of Umakant Yadav, a sitting BSP MP from Machhlishahr, who was convicted in a land-grabbing case. When police failed to arrest him, the DGP informed Mayawati. She summoned Umakant Yadav to her residence, and he was arrested as soon as he arrived. His political career ended thereafter. Entry of criminals banned after controversy Mayawati follows a strict protocol for meetings. No one can meet her without recommendations from the district president and divisional coordinator. Even party tickets follow unofficial eligibility guidelines, and only those fulfilling the criteria are allowed entry into the party. The incident involving the Meerut criminals has therefore caused major embarrassment for the BSP. When asked for a response, Vikram Singh declined comment, saying that West UP in-charge Naushad Ali would speak on the issue. Naushad Ali also refused to comment, confirming only that the entry of both individuals has been banned.

stories.title: Wedding procession turns violent in Noida, 20 rounds fired:40 goons armed with sticks axes chase guests; 10 critically injured, shifted to ICU
stories.summary: More than 40 goons attacked a wedding procession in Greater Noida, chasing and assaulting guests with sticks and axes, while around 20 rounds were fired. Ten members of the wedding party were seriously injured. All the injured, who belong to the same family, have been admitted to a private hospital and are undergoing treatment in the ICU. A video of the attack has surfaced. The incident occurred in Jagannathpur village under the Dankaur police station area. See 3 pictures Know the full story Old enmity coming to light After the attack, the accused fled from the spot. Subsequently, the injured have been admitted to Kailash Hospital in Greater Noida. The condition of the injured is serious. All are admitted to the ICU. As soon as the information about this commotion was received, police forces from several police stations reached Rampur village. The police have formed two teams in this matter and have started searching for the attackers. It is being said that there was already a dispute between these people over some issue. The other party also belongs to Jagannpur village, and there was a fight between these people a few days ago as well. 20 to 25 rounds of firing were done Deepak Nagar said, A wedding procession went from our village. Our father, grandfather, uncle, and the entire family went in the procession. During the 'milai' (welcoming ceremony) at the wedding, 40 people arrived in vehicles and attacked. They had sticks, axes, and rifles. 20 to 25 rounds of firing were done. In this attack, 10 members of our family are injured. Everyone's condition is serious. They are undergoing treatment in the ICU. The reason for the attack is unknown. The attackers fled from the scene. Fight occurred three months ago ADCP Sudhir Kumar said, Both parties are residents of Jaganpur village. A fight broke out at the wedding procession over an old rivalry. Several people were injured in the assault and are undergoing treatment at the hospital. Police have registered a case based on the complaint of the victim party. stories.title: Lightning strikes in Barabanki and Etah:Hail reported in 2 districts, rain lashes 10 Uttar Pradesh cities; IMD warns of wind, temperature drop
stories.summary: The weather turned unsettled across Uttar Pradesh on Saturday, with light rain, hailstorms and lightning incidents reported from several districts. Early morning drizzle was recorded in Lucknow, Kanpur, Hardoi and 10 districts of eastern Uttar Pradesh, while hail fell late at night in Hathras and Etawah, triggering panic as pea-sized hailstones pelted the ground. Lightning strikes caused damage in parts of the State. In Barabanki, electric meters installed outside houses were burnt after being struck by lightning. In Etah, lightning hit a tractor-trolley late at night, resulting in a major fire at the spot. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) said the impact of heavy snowfall and intense rainfall in the hill States was clearly visible over Uttar Pradesh. An alert for rain and hail has been issued for 15 districts, while strong winds with speeds of 40–50 kmph are likely in 20 districts. Weather fluctuations are expected to persist over the next four days, bringing an end to the brief relief from fog and cold. Temperatures may drop by 3–4°C. On Friday, rain was reported in 20 districts of western Uttar Pradesh. In several areas, including Noida and Ghaziabad, showers that began late at night continued intermittently through the day, accompanied by strong winds. Hail was reported in Meerut, flattening crops in the fields. A lightning strike on a church led to a fire. Agricultural experts said the rainfall would benefit wheat, lentils and gram crops, but could damage mustard and potato crops. Farmers have been advised to monitor weather updates closely and undertake protective spraying if required to minimise losses. Atul Kumar Singh, senior scientist at the Regional Meteorological Centre, Lucknow, said another western disturbance would become active over the State from January 27. “Day and night temperatures will continue to fluctuate. Minimum temperatures may rise in western Uttar Pradesh, while cloud cover could lead to a drop in daytime temperatures over central Uttar Pradesh,” he said. See weather pictures Orange alert in these 15 districts today Saharanpur, Shamli, Muzaffarnagar, Meerut, Hapur, Bulandshahr, Aligarh, Kasganj, Bijnor, Amroha, Moradabad, Rampur, Bareilly, Sambhal, Badaun. Dust storm alert at 40-50 speed in these 20 districts Saharanpur, Shamli, Muzaffarnagar, Baghpat, Meerut, Ghaziabad, Hapur, Gautam Buddh Nagar, Bulandshahr, Aligarh, Kasganj, Bijnor, Amroha, Moradabad, Rampur, Bareilly, Pilibhit, Shahjahanpur, Sambhal, Badaun. How will the weather be for 2 days? Rain beneficial for wheat-lentil According to agricultural experts, this rain is beneficial for wheat, lentils, and gram crops, but mustard and potato crops may be damaged. Farmers have been advised to monitor weather conditions and spray pesticides on crops if necessary to avoid damage.

stories.title: Minister Anil Rajbhar calls OP Rajbhar a 'Thief', video surfaces:Loses temper at SBSP supporters in Varanasi; forcibly removes them from event
stories.summary: Anil Rajbhar, Minister of Labour and Service Employment in the UP government, lashed out at Cabinet Minister Omprakash Rajbhar on Friday. He even called Omprakash Rajbhar and his supporters thieves. The birth anniversary of Maharaja Suheldev Rajbhar was being celebrated in Suheldev Park, Varanasi. Anil Rajbhar was speaking about Maharaja Suheldev from the stage. Meanwhile, OP Rajbhar's supporters, wearing yellow scarves, started shouting slogans. Initially, the organisers tried to stop those shouting slogans, but it didn't work. Seeing this, Anil Rajbhar became furious. From the stage, Anil Rajbhar said, Just as their leader is a thief, so are all of them. They work to sell society. Minister Rajbhar, pointing towards his supporters, said, All of them should be removed from here. After this, OP Rajbhar's supporters were started to be removed from the event venue by Anil Rajbhar's supporters. The atmosphere had become very tense. Anil Rajbhar not in favour of alliance OP Rajbhar Spoke to BJP Leadership Sources say that after Anil Rajbhar's statement, OP Rajbhar spoke to the BJP leadership and objected to such statements. OP Rajbhar has currently refused to comment on the matter. Earlier, BJP's Nishad leaders had also made statements against NDA's other ally, Rashtriya Lok Dal, against Yogi government's Sugarcane Development Minister Chaudhary Laxminarayan, and against Nishad Party president Sanjay Nishad.

stories.title: रोस्टर के अनुसार बच्चों का बनाएं आधार कार्ड
stories.summary: महराजगंज के डीएम संतोष कुमार शर्मा ने सभी उपडाकघर निरीक्षकों को पत्र भेजकर 0-5 वर्ष के बच्चों का आधार कार्ड बनाने के लिए निर्देश दिए हैं। उन्होंने कहा कि आंगनबाड़ी केंद्रों में नामांकित बच्चों का आधार बनाने के लिए रोस्टर तैयार किया जाए और प्राथमिकता के आधार पर काम किया जाए।

stories.title: महिला की संदिग्ध परिस्थितियों में मौत

stories.title: अब 300 बेड अस्पताल में सर्जन से भी मिलेगा परामर्श, की गई तैनाती
stories.summary: अब 300 बेड अस्पताल में मरीजों को सर्जन से परामर्श मिल सकेगी। सीएमओ ने सर्जन की तैनाती के आदेश दिए हैं, जिससे गंभीर मरीजों को जिला अस्पताल के चक्कर नहीं लगाने पड़ेंगे। अस्पताल में प्राथमिक उपचार भी मिलेगा। नए सर्जन की सेवाएं शनिवार से शुरू होंगी, जिससे ओपीडी में मरीजों को राहत मिलेगी।

stories.title: प्रस्तावित हड़ताल के समर्थन में बैंककर्मियों का प्रदर्शन
stories.summary: वाराणसी में बैंककर्मियों ने 27 जनवरी को प्रस्तावित हड़ताल के समर्थन में प्रदर्शन किया। कर्मचारियों ने विभिन्न स्थानों पर एकजुट होकर नारेबाजी की। इस हड़ताल से सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के बैंक चार दिनों तक बंद रहेंगे। प्रदर्शन में कार्य समय बढ़ाने और शनिवार को छुट्टी घोषित करने की मांग की गई।

stories.title: तीन वर्षों में पंचायत भवन का निर्माण अधूरा
stories.summary: कटहरी के ग्राम सभा रमपुरवा में पंचायत भवन का निर्माण तीन वर्ष बाद भी अधूरा है। इस वजह से रोजगार सेवक और ग्रामीणों को कठिनाई का सामना करना पड़ रहा है। ग्राम प्रधान फिरोज खान ने बताया कि इस भवन का निर्माण 13 लाख 94 हजार रुपए की लागत से होना है, लेकिन काम अभी तक पूरा नहीं हुआ है।

stories.title: मौत की सिरप: शुभम के पिता, मां और पत्नी की 28.50 करोड़ की संपत्ति जब्त

stories.title: एसएसवी इंटर कॉलेज में वसंत पंचमी पर हुई मां सरस्वती की पूजा

stories.title: प्रभातफेरी में लाठीचार्ज में सीओ हटाये, एलआईयू सिपाही निलंबित

stories.summary: ग्राम भुवनी में शतचंडी महायज्ञ के दौरान कथावाचक पंडित सुधीर द्विवेदी ने महर्षि दधीचि की कहानी सुनाई। दधीचि की पत्नी ने पति के वियोग में सती हो गई। उनके 3 वर्षीय पुत्र ने पीपल के फल खाकर जीवन बिताया। देवर्षि नारद के मार्गदर्शन से बालक पिप्पलाद ने ब्रह्मा जी की तपस्या कर शक्ति मांगी।

stories.summary: महराजगंज की नगर पालिका परिषद की अध्यक्ष डॉ. पुष्पलता मंगल ने मुख्यालय रोड और सुकठिया क्षेत्र का निरीक्षण किया। उन्होंने साफ-सफाई व्यवस्था और स्ट्रीट लाइट की स्थिति का जायजा लिया। टूटे विद्युत पोल की सूचना तुरंत विद्युत विभाग को दी गई। नागरिकों को बेहतर सुविधाएं प्रदान करना नगर पालिका की प्राथमिकता है।

stories.title: ताला तोड़कर विद्यालय में हुई चोरी, हजारों का सामान गायब

stories.title: दूसरे दिन 57 केंद्रों पर 5429 परीक्षार्थियों ने दी प्रयोगात्मक परीक्षा
stories.summary: यूपी बोर्ड की प्रयोगात्मक परीक्षाएं शनिवार से शुरू हुईं। बरेली में 57 केंद्रों पर रविवार को 5429 छात्रों ने परीक्षा दी। परीक्षा का आयोजन सीसीटीवी कैमरों की निगरानी में किया गया। डॉ. अजीत कुमार और डीएम द्वारा नामित अधिकारियों ने केंद्रों का औचक निरीक्षण किया। सभी केंद्रों पर परीक्षा सुचारु रूप से संचालित हुई।

stories.title: 16 वां राष्ट्रीय मतदाता दिवस समारोह में कार्यक्रम का आयोजन

stories.title: ऑदियोज में विद्यार्थियों ने बांधा समां, दी विदाई
stories.summary: माधवराव सिंधिया पब्लिक स्कूल में रविवार को ऑदियोज का आयोजन हुआ, जिसमें शिक्षकों ने विदाई का अर्थ बताया। कार्यक्रम में खेल प्रतियोगिताएं हुईं। अंत में प्रधानाचार्या डा. प्रियंका सरकार और विद्यालय प्रबंधक डॉ. सौरभ कुमार अग्रवाल ने विदाई लेने वाले बच्चों के उज्ज्वल भविष्य की कामना की।

stories.title: धान खरीद की समस्या को लेकर सौंपा ज्ञापन
stories.summary: देवरिया में राजकीय इंटर कॉलेज में किसान मेला के दौरान भाकियू के प्रतिनिधिमंडल ने कृषि मंत्री को धान खरीद की समस्या पर ज्ञापन सौंपा। उन्होंने सभी क्रय केंद्रों पर प्रतिदिन 200 कुंतल धान खरीदने और रावतपार में दो कांटे लगाने की मांग की।

stories.title: बरेली कॉलेज के प्रो. राजेंद्र सिंह बने उज्बेकिस्तान की यूनिवर्सिटी के अंतर्राष्ट्रीय विजिटर
stories.summary: बरेली कॉलेज के प्राणी विज्ञान विभाग के वरिष्ठ प्राध्यापक प्रो. राजेन्द्र सिंह को उज्बेकिस्तान की अल्माइक स्टेट टेक्निकल इंस्टीट्यूट द्वारा शैक्षणिक सहयोग के लिए आमंत्रित किया गया है। वे 27 जनवरी को उज्बेकिस्तान के लिए रवाना होंगे और इस यात्रा के दौरान छात्रों व शोधार्थियों के साथ संवाद करेंगे।

stories.title: शहीद सरज सिंह को याद कर श्रद्धांजलि
stories.summary: सिंधौली की सिंदूर फिजिकल एकेडमी में शहीद सरज सिंह की शहादत को याद करने के लिए एक भावपूर्ण श्रद्धांजलि कार्यक्रम आयोजित किया गया। इस कार्यक्रम की अध्यक्षता रिटायर्ड सेना जवान ठाकुर उमेश प्रताप सिंह ने की। शहीद की पत्नी ने भी नम आंखों से अपने पति को श्रद्धांजलि दी। सभी ने शहीदों को याद किया।

stories.title: इस बार निडर होकर आकलन करेंगी डीएलएड प्रशिक्षु, होगी सुरक्षा
stories.summary: देवरिया में परिषदीय विद्यालयों में कक्षा एक एवं दो के बच्चों का आकलन डीएलएड प्रशिक्षुओं द्वारा किया जाएगा। निपुण प्लस एप पर एसओएस बटन की सुविधा के साथ, प्रशिक्षु असुरक्षा की स्थिति में तुरंत सहायता प्राप्त कर सकेंगे। 75% सही उत्तर देने वाले बच्चे निपुण विद्यार्थी घोषित होंगे और विद्यालय भी निपुणता के मानक परखेंगे।

stories.title: नींव भरी जमीन पर कब्जे का आरोप, एसडीएम से शिकायत
stories.summary: जठियापुर बुजुर्ग में वीरेंद्र कुमार ने उप जिलाधिकारी से शिकायत की है कि उनकी 30 वर्षों से नींव भरी जमीन पर गांव के प्रधान ने रंजिश के चलते अन्नपूर्णा भवन का निर्माण कराया है। उन्होंने कार्रवाई की मांग की है और निर्माण कार्य को रुकवाने की अपील की है।

stories.title: प्रथम बार मतदाता बने युवाओं का हुआ सम्मान, लोकतंत्र के पर्व में भाग लेने की अपील
stories.summary: पुवायां क्षेत्र में राष्ट्रीय मतदाता दिवस 2026 का आयोजन 'मेरा युवा भारत' द्वारा भव्य रूप से किया गया। कार्यक्रम में युवाओं का सम्मान, मतदाता शपथ, रंगोली, और जागरूकता संवाद जैसी गतिविधियाँ शामिल थीं। मुख्य अतिथि ने युवाओं को सक्रिय लोकतांत्रिक भागीदारी के लिए प्रेरित किया। यह कार्यक्रम युवा सहभागिता को सुनिश्चित करने के लिए एक पहल है।

stories.title: छात्राओं के बीच युवक ने दौड़ाया घोड़ा, मना करने पर शिक्षक को पीटा
stories.summary: गौरीबाजार में वसंत पंचमी के अवसर पर मां सरस्वती की प्रतिमा विर्सजित करने के दौरान कुछ युवकों ने घोड़ा दौड़ाना शुरू कर दिया। छात्रों के विरोध करने पर युवक मारपीट पर उतारू हो गए, जिससे एक शिक्षक और छात्र घायल हो गए। विद्यालय प्रबंधक ने पुलिस से कार्रवाई की मांग की है।

stories.title: छात्रा ने जमा की पूरी फीस, फिर भी कॉलेज ने नहीं किया रेजिस्ट्रेशन, परीक्षा के समय हुआ खुलासा
stories.summary: सरधना के एक कॉलेज में छात्रा ने फीस लेकर पंजीकरण न कराने का आरोप लगाया है। छात्रा ने थाने में तहरीर देकर पुलिस से कार्रवाई की मांग की है। छात्रा ने पहले 10 हजार रुपये फीस जमा किए थे, लेकिन कॉलेज ने उसका नाम पंजीकरण में नहीं भेजा, जिससे उसका शैक्षणिक सत्र बर्बाद हो गया।

stories.title: Europe financing 'war' against itself by buying Russian oil products from India: Bessent

stories.title: गंगनहर की पटरी किनारे जंगल में मिला अज्ञात शव, मचा हड़कंप
stories.summary: मवाना के वीर नगर में रविवार को गंगनहर के किनारे एक अज्ञात शव मिला। पुलिस ने शव की पहचान कराने की कोशिश की लेकिन असफल रही। शव लगभग चार से पांच दिन पुराना प्रतीत होता है और पोस्टमार्टम के लिए भेजा गया है। पुलिस मामले की जांच कर रही है और पहचान के प्रयास जारी हैं।

stories.title: अल्लाह हू अकबर...गणतंत्र दिवस पर मदरसा छात्रों से लगवाए मजहबी नारे, तिरंगा लेकर निकाला जुलूस
stories.summary: गणतंत्र दिवस के मौके पर बागपत का एक वीडियो वायरल हुआ है। वीडियो में मदरसा छात्रों से मजहबी नारा लगवाया गया। साथ ही हाथों में तिरंगा लेकर पूरे गांव में जुलूस निकलवाया गया। बच्चों से मजहबी नारा लगवाए जाने पर हिंदू संगठन में आक्रोश है।

stories.title: China has purged its highest-ranked military general. Why?

stories.title: चौधरी चरण सिंह यूनिवर्सिटी में बीटेक के छात्र पर हमला, तान दिया तमंचा

stories.title: धूमधाम से मना 77वां गणतंत्र दिवस, उच्च शिक्षा राज्य मंत्री ने परेड की ली सलामी
stories.summary: हरदोई में 77वां गणतंत्र दिवस उत्साह और गरिमा के साथ मनाया गया। विभिन्न कार्यक्रमों का आयोजन किया गया, जिसमें तिरंगा फहराया गया और मुख्य अतिथि रजनी तिवारी ने पुलिस लाइन में परेड का निरीक्षण किया। सांस्कृतिक कार्यक्रमों ने सभी का मन मोह लिया और उत्कृष्ट कार्य करने वाले पुलिस अधिकारियों को सम्मानित किया गया।

stories.title: Rights group says Iran protest toll nears 6,000 dead

stories.title: जो भी बोलूंगा…, यूजीसी के नए नियमों पर विरोध के सवाल पर क्या बोले बृजभूषण शरण सिंह
stories.summary: बृजभूषण शरण सिंह ने कहा कि UGC के नए नियमों का विषय बहुत गंभीर है इसलिए मैं इसको अध्ययन कर रहा हूं। जो कुछ भी बोलूंगा बहुत सोच-समझकर बोलूंगा क्योंकि यह समाज से जुड़ा मुद्दा है। कोई सामंजस्य निकलना चाहिए तो बिना जानकारी के मैं इस पर बोलना नहीं चाहता हूं।

stories.title: हनी ट्रैप में फंसाकर 10 लाख की डिमांड, सभासद अरेस्ट, महिला और 2 पुलिसकर्मी फरार

SCR Vijayawada officials celebrate Republic Day

stories.summary: इकदिल पिलखर नहर के पास आगरा-कानपुर नेशनल हाईवे पर तेज रफ्तार डंपर ने पुलिस जीप को टक्कर मार दी, जिसमें थाना प्रभारी प्रीति सिंह घायल हो गईं। यह हादसा गणतंत्र दिवस की परेड से लौटते समय हुआ। स्थानीय लोगों ने पुलिस कर्मियों को बाहर निकाला और प्रीति सिंह को अस्पताल भेजा गया। डंपर चालक मौके से फरार हो गया।

stories.title: Israel says it has retrieved remains of final Gaza hostage
stories.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu called Ran Gvili’s return "an extraordinary achievement".

stories.title: What is the Board of Peace?
यूजीसी के नए नियमों को लेकर बढ़ा विरोध, PCअफसर के बाद अब भाजपा कार्यकर्ताओं का इस्तीफा
stories.summary: केंद्र सरकार द्वारा लाए गए यूजीसी के नियमों को लेकर विरोध अब तेज होने लगा है। नए नियमों का विरोध अब केवल आम लोगों में ही नहीं बल्कि प्रशासनिक अफसर और भाजपा कार्यकर्ताओं में भी देखने को मिला है।

stories.summary: लखनऊ : सपा प्रमुख अखिलेश यादव ने गणतंत्र दिवस के मौके पर कार्यकर्ताओं को संबोधित किया। इस दौरान उन्होंने योगी आदित्यनाथ पर तंज कसा और कहा कि कुछ लोग नींद से तो उठ जाते हैं, लेकिन होश में नहीं आते हैं। आंखें दिनभर बंद रहती हैं…जाग कर भी मदहोश रहते हैं।

stories.title: कॉलेज का नाम बदलने पर आक्रोश, प्रदर्शन
stories.summary: ताहपुर में एक इंटर कॉलेज का नाम बदलने को लेकर विवाद खड़ा हो गया है। गणतंत्र दिवस पर नए नाम का पोस्टर लगाने पर पूर्व उपाध्यक्ष गौरव पटेल ने विरोध प्रदर्शन किया। उन्होंने कॉलेज प्रबंधन पर गंभीर आरोप लगाए हैं कि बिना सूचना के 41 सदस्यों को निष्कासित किया गया। इस मामले में पुलिस जांच कर रही है।

stories.title: बरेली के सिटी मजिस्ट्रेट ने शंकराचार्य के अपमान और यूजीसी कानून के विरोध में दिया इस्तीफा
stories.summary: बरेली के सिटी मजिस्ट्रेट अलंकार अग्निहोत्री ने शंकराचार्य के अपमान और यूजीसी के नए नियमों के विरोध में इस्तीफा दिया। उन्होंने कहा कि यह निर्णय सोच-समझकर लिया गया है और वह इसे वापस नहीं लेंगे। उन्होंने सोशल मीडिया पर अपने विरोध का प्रदर्शन किया, जिससे उनके समर्थन में कई संगठन सड़कों पर उतरे।

stories.summary: मेरठ में पति-पत्नी और वो जैसा मामला सामने आया है। यहां एक महिला को दूसरे युवक से प्रेम-प्रसंग चल रहा था। महिला अपने पति को धोखा दे रही थी। इंजीनियर पति को जब इसकी जानकारी हुई तो वह पत्नी पर नजर रखने लगा।

stories.title: कौन हैं सिटी मजिस्ट्रेट अलंकार अग्निहोत्री, शंकराचार्य के अपमान और UGC एक्ट के खिलाफ दिया इस्तीफा
stories.summary: शंकराचार्य स्वामी अविमुक्ते्श्वरानंद के बटुकों के अपमान और यूजीसी के नए रेगुलेशन के खिलाफ इस्तीफा देने वाले पीसीएस अफसर और बरेली के सिटी मजिस्ट्रेट अलंकार अग्निहोत्री का सफर संघर्षों से भरा रहा है। बचपन में ही पिता का निधन हो गया। प्राइवेट नौकरी करने के बाद पीसीएस बने थे।

stories.title: बृजभूषण शरण सिंह इस सीट से लड़ सकते हैं लोकसभा चुनाव 2029; दिए संकेत
stories.summary: यूपी के कैसरगंज से बीजेपी के पूर्व सांसद बृजभूषण शरण सिंह आज बारांबकी थे। कार्यक्रम के दौरान बृजभूषण ने 2029 के लोकसभा चुनाव को लेकर अयोध्या सीट से चुनाव लड़ने के संकेत दिए हैं।

stories.title: दुर्घटना में घायल बाइक सवार की इलाज के दौरान मौत
stories.summary: कांट में गंगा स्नान के लिए जा रहे बाइक सवार दंपति की सड़क दुर्घटना में गंभीर चोट आई। पति राजाराम की इलाज के दौरान मौत हो गई, जबकि पत्नी पुष्पा देवी का उपचार जारी है। घटना से परिवार में कोहराम मचा है। पुलिस ने शव को पोस्टमार्टम के लिए भेजा है और पत्नी की हालत गंभीर है।

stories.title: पीलीभीत में अलग-अलग हादसों में दो घायल, सीएचसी में कराया गया भर्ती
stories.summary: पीलीभीत के पूरनपुर में सोमवार को दो अलग-अलग सड़क हादसों में दो लोग घायल हो गए। पहले हादसे में बाइक सवार उमाशंकर को अज्ञात वाहन ने टक्कर मारी। दूसरे हादसे में तेज रफ्तार ट्रक बिजली पोल से टकरा गया। दोनों घायलों को सामुदायिक स्वास्थ्य केंद्र में भर्ती कराया गया है।

stories.title: यूपी में एक फरवरी को होने वाला विशेष अभियान टला, निर्वाचन आयोग ने बताई ये वजह
stories.summary: एक फरवरी 2026 को प्रदेश के सभी मतदेय स्थलों पर विशेष कैंपेन दिवस आयोजित किये जाने थे। इसके लिए सभी जिला निर्वाचन अधिकारियों को निर्देश दिए गए थे। अब एक फरवरी को होने वाला अभियान टाल दिया गया है। इस दिन संत रविदास जयंती होने के चलते यह निर्णय लिया गया है।

stories.summary: पीलीभीत में भारतीय किसान यूनियन ने तिरंगा यात्रा निकाली। किसानों ने मंडी से कलेक्ट्रेट तक अपनी समस्याओं को लेकर आवाज उठाई। मंडल अध्यक्ष सतविंदर सिंह खेलो के नेतृत्व में निकली ट्रैक्टर रैली का समापन डीएम दफ्तर पर ज्ञापन सौंपने के साथ हुआ। किसानों ने समस्याओं के जल्द समाधान की मांग की।

stories.title: संदिग्ध हालात में पेड़ से लटका मिला युवक का शव
stories.summary: लखीमपुर के धौरहरा क्षेत्र के रहबड़ी गांव में एक युवक रामगोपाल का शव संदिग्ध हालात में पेड़ से लटकता मिला। मृतक के परिजनों ने बताया कि उसने अज्ञात कारणों से आत्महत्या की। रामगोपाल पीछे दो लड़कियों और एक लड़के को छोड़ गया है। पुलिस ने शव को कब्जे में लेकर पोस्टमार्टम के लिए भेज दिया।

stories.title: Former Philippines President Duterte fit for pre-trial hearings, ICC judges rule

stories.title: हर्षोल्लास के साथ मनाया गया गणतंत्र दिवस
stories.summary: बरेली के वीरांगना अवंतीबाई लोधी राजकीय महिला महाविद्यालय में 77वां गणतंत्र दिवस हर्षोल्लास के साथ मनाया गया। प्राचार्य प्रो. मनीषा राव ने ध्वजारोहण किया और राष्ट्रगान गाया गया। सांस्कृतिक कार्यक्रम में 'वन्दे मातरम्' और गणतंत्र दिवस गीत प्रस्तुत किए गए। भाषण प्रतियोगिता का आयोजन भी किया गया, जिसमें अनेकता में एकता का विषय था।

stories.title: Minneapolis locals protest inhumane U.S. agents after second killing by ICE
stories.summary: Federal agents shot to death 37-year-old ICU nurse Alex Pretti; Trump and his officials quickly defended the officer who fired the shots, who has neither been suspended nor charged

stories.title: Patta transfer in Tamil Nadu: Officials asked to digitally process applications
stories.summary: The Director of Survey and Settlement has instructed Collectors and Assistant Directors of Survey and Land Records not to process manual note files and not to manually approve sub-division statements by Tahsildars.

stories.title: स्वतंत्रता संग्राम सेनानियों के परिजनों को शाल ओढ़ाकर किया सम्मानित
stories.summary: बरेली में 77वें गणतंत्र दिवस पर जिलाधिकारी अविनाश सिंह ने कलेक्ट्रेट परिसर में ध्वजारोहण किया। उन्होंने स्वतंत्रता संग्राम सेनानियों के परिजनों को शाल ओढ़ाकर सम्मानित किया। उन्होंने जातिवाद और धर्मवाद से ऊपर उठकर राष्ट्रवाद की भावना को आत्मसात करने की अपील की। इसके अलावा, छात्राओं ने देशभक्ति गीत गाए और कई को प्रशस्ति पत्र दिए गए।

stories.title: शहीद स्मारक पर पुष्पांजलि अर्पित कर शहीदों को दी श्रद्धांजलि
stories.summary: बरेली में 77 वां गणतंत्र दिवस धूमधाम से मनाया गया। मंडलायुक्त भूपेंद्र एस चौधरी ने ध्वजारोहण किया और संविधान संकल्प को दोहराया। उन्होंने शहीद स्मारक पर श्रद्धांजलि अर्पित की। मंडलायुक्त ने समय और तकनीक के साथ बदलाव की आवश्यकता पर जोर दिया और ई-ऑफिस के माध्यम से पत्रावलियों के संचालन की शुरुआत की।

stories.title: UP Metro sets target of developed India by 2047:Celebrations at depots and stations on Republic Day; future plans shared
stories.summary: When the heartbeat of the city, the Kanpur Metro, starts dancing to the rhythm of patriotism, you know the scene is something special. On the glorious occasion of the 77th Republic Day, such a flood of enthusiasm swept through Kanpur Metro Depot and stations that every heart called out 'Jai Hind'. Resolution and high aspirations for developed India The ceremony began at the Metro Depot located at Gurudev Chauraha, where UPMRC Project Director Arvind Meena hoisted the tricolor and gave the salute. Meanwhile, Managing Director Sushil Kumar conducted the flag hoisting in Lucknow and administered the oath of 'Developed India' to everyone. MD Sushil Kumar shared an enthusiastic vision, stating that Uttar Pradesh's metro network is now unstoppable. He said, "UPMRC has a crucial role in making India a developed nation by 2047. Today, we are at the third position in the metro network globally and will soon be at the second position." 'Blood of Patriotism' flows at Motijheel The true meaning of the Republic is service to society. Exemplifying this, a massive blood donation camp was organized at Motijheel Metro Station. Citizens and metro staff participated enthusiastically in this camp, organized in collaboration with Sankalp Seva Samiti, Big FM, and IIT Kanpur. Future 'Metro Map' will drive progress in UP: The future picture presented by UPMRC is nothing less than a golden dream. Almost every major city in the state will get the speed of the metro: Kanpur: 200 km proposed network. Lucknow: Expansion up to 225 km. Agra, Varanasi, Prayagraj, and Noida: Hundreds of km of new network. Ayodhya, Mathura, and Jhansi: Metro will also make its presence on 50-50 km tracks here. Number 1 in efficiency, UP Metro on track for profits It should be noted that UPMRC has also set benchmarks in management. In tier-2 cities like Kanpur and Agra, the metro is not only safe and punctual, but is also setting national standards with minimum costs and maximum revenue. In terms of operational efficiency, it is competing with some of the world's best systems.

stories.title: Student commits suicide after mother scolds him for flying kites:Boy scolded in front of friends, body found hanging on second floor in Meerut
stories.summary: A Class-9 student died by suicide in Meerut after being scolded by his mother for flying kites. The boy had been flying kites for the past three days, following which his mother reprimanded him in front of his friends. Distressed by this, the student went to his room on the second floor of the house around 11 am on Monday. When his friends went to check on him at around 12:30 pm, they found him hanging. Police reached the spot after being informed and sent the body for a post-mortem. The incident took place in Sector-3 of Shastri Nagar under the Nauchandi police station area. Anant Chauhan (14), a Class 9 student of Vidya Mandir School, was the son of Vinay Chauhan, who works as a driver. According to the family, Anant had been flying kites continuously for the past two days. Even on Basant Panchami, despite the rainfall, he went to the rooftop to fly kites. On January 26, a holiday, Anant again went to the roof with his friends early in the morning to fly kites. Around 11 am, his mother scolded him in front of his friends, asking him to stop flying kites and focus on his studies. She told him that he had been flying kites for the last three days. Anant reportedly became upset after being reprimanded publicly. Family refused to conduct postmortem Anant became very angry with his mother. After this, he went to his room on the second floor of the house. He did not come out of the room for one and a half hours. Around 12:30, Anant's friends, after flying kites, came down from the roof and searched for him in his room. They saw Anant's body hanging from a noose. He had made a noose from a dupatta. After this, friends raised an alarm. They called Anant's parents by shouting. In a hurry, when family members came to his room, they fainted upon seeing their son's body. Police arrived on information, and family members took him to Popular Hospital after bringing him down. The doctors declared him dead. Police also questioned family members and neighbors about the incident. The family members refused to conduct a post-mortem. After this, the police handed over the body to them.

stories.title: Padma Shri awarded to 3 personalities from Lucknow:Anil Rastogi worked in 75 films; Thakral Ayurveda expert, Rajendra medicine specialist
stories.summary: Two renowned doctors from Lucknow and one theater artist will be honored with Padma Shri for their excellent services. These include well-known respiratory and TB specialists and former HOD of KGMU, Dr. Rajendra Prasad, and former principal of Government Ayurvedic College, Tudiyaganj, Dr. Kewal Krishna Thakral. Additionally, CDRI scientist and famous theater artist, film actor Dr. Anil Rastogi's name has also been announced. The central government announced the names of Padma award recipients on the eve of Republic Day. Dr. Rajendra Prasad, who has been selected for the Padma Shri award, is also known as the father of KGMU's Pulmonary Medicine department. He has served from student to HOD in KGMU's Pulmonary Medicine department. Dainik Bhaskar had special conversations with all three personalities. Read the report... Read what Dr. Rajendra Prasad said... Dr. Rajendra Prasad said that as soon as the name was announced, people started calling. It's a big day, a big moment. Today I would like to thank all those people who supported me in this journey. Feeling proud to receive this honor. Born in Basti, served patients in Lucknow Dr. Rajendra was born in 1950 in Mundera town of Basti. After completing his early education from Mundera, he did his high school from Khalilabad and intermediate from Christian College, Lucknow. In 1970, he got admission in MBBS at KGMU. After this, he completed his MD from the same institution. In 1984, he joined KGMU as a teacher. Later, he became the Head of the Department of Respiratory Medicine here. Achieved Success with Family's Support Dr. Rajendra Prasad shared that his late father, Gopichand, was a cloth merchant, and his late mother, Vijay Lakshmi, was a housewife. His son, Dr. Nikhit Gupta, is a teacher in the Medicine department at Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia Institute. His daughter, Dr. Pallavi, is a dentist and is married. He credited his wife, Meera Gupta, and family for helping him reach this far. Read what Dr. Thakral said about the honor... Father's inspiration led to becoming an Ayurvedic doctor Dr. Kewal Krishna Thakral, former principal of Government Ayurvedic College Tudiyaganj, expressed happiness on being selected for the Padma Shri award. He shared that besides his father, three brothers are also doctors. He became an Ayurvedic doctor inspired by them. Dr. Thakral said that he took admission in BAMS in 1964 at the Government Ayurvedic College, Tudiyaganj. Dr. KK Thakral, who lives in E Block of Rajajipuram, shared that he journeyed from lecturer to principal and director in Ayurvedic colleges. He retired in 1996. He presented 66 research papers, of which 54 were published in India and 12 abroad. He wrote several books, including the principles of Shalya Tantra. His book on Kshara Sutra surgery expertise was published in English. Received many Honors Dr. Thakral has received many honors like Ayurveda Ratnakar Award in 1991, the Ayurveda Brihaspati Award in 1992, National Herbal Conservation Award in 2010. He has also received the National Ayurveda Vidyapeeth, New Delhi, 2001 Fellowship. Now learn about theater artist Dr. Anil Rastogi... Dr. Rastogi is simple, natural, and accessible 83 years of age, around a thousand stage performances as an actor in a hundred plays, more than 75 films, and acting in more than 14 web series and TV serials. Despite so many achievements, it's not easy to remain simple, natural and accessible. Dr. Anil Rastogi loves Lucknow dearly, and Lucknow is equally fond of him. When the news of his receiving the Padma Shri honor came, the city residents were overjoyed. Gave credit for success to wife Anil, who was a scientist at CDRI, remained associated with Darpan Theatre Group. He said that along with the love of audiences, the government has also honored my work, which is a matter of great joy. My wife, Sudha Rastogi, has made a big contribution to my journey so far. Dr. Anil Rastogi has received Yash Bharati-2017, Sangeet Natak Akademi Award-2023, Pataliputra Lifetime Achievement Award 2024, Abhyudaya International Shalaka Honor-2026, and Kalidas Honor. Lucknow received 13 Padma Awards in 5 years In the past five years, the capital received 13 Padma Awards. Out of these, 10 awards were received during three years. In 2025, Dr. Sonia Nityanand - Medicine, Hriday Narayan Dixit - Literature and Education, and Satyapal Singh - Sports were honored with Padma Awards. In 2024, four luminaries, including SGPGI Director Dr. RK Dhiman, received this honor.

stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest news from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top news headlines of the day: 1. All 3 Shankaracharyas back Avimukteshwaranand, says Sadanand Saraswati Dwarka Sharda Peeth Shankaracharya Swami Sadanand Saraswati says all three Shankaracharyas support Avimukteshwaranand and questions the administration’s authority to seek any certificate. He condemns police action, calling the assault on innocent Brahmins reprehensible, while speaking at the Narmada Janmotsav in Jabalpur. 2. Republic Day parade highlights Op Sindoor's integrated command centre Republic Day parade showcased the Integrated Command used in Operation Sindoor, highlighting India’s modern defence coordination and strategic preparedness. A spectacular flypast featured 29 aircraft, including Sukhoi and Rafale jets, adding grandeur to the celebrations. 3. Bahraich road accident kills three youths as car crashes into tree A WagonR car hits a tree on a highway in Bahraich, killing three youths on the spot as the vehicle shatters completely. Two others, friends of the deceased, are critically injured and undergoing treatment in the hospital. 4. Chinese General Accused of Leaking Nuclear Secrets to United States China’s CMC Vice Chairman Zhang Youxia is under investigation for allegedly sharing nuclear weapons information with the US. The allegation was reported by The Wall Street Journal, citing American intelligence sources. 5. Teacher slits student’s throat in Kanpur Dehat An 11th-grade student was allegedly murdered by his teacher in Kanpur Dehat after being called near the school and attacked with a knife. The 17-year-old named the teacher before dying during treatment. Police cite a money dispute; the accused is absconding. 6. Akhilesh’s soft outreach signals recalibration before 2027 Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav’s recent conciliatory moves, visiting the CM’s aide, backing Shankaracharya, and offering humanitarian help are being seen as a strategic attempt to broaden his appeal beyond PDA and soften political edges ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh polls. 7. Govt plans for facial recognition in Aadhaar instead of fingerprints The government has begun work on major changes to Aadhaar’s technical system under a new document called Aadhaar Vision 2032. Facial recognition is planned to replace fingerprints as the main identification method. 8. Western disturbances sharpen cold across U.P. Cold conditions intensified across Uttar Pradesh as two western disturbances set in. Rain is forecast on January 27–28, with night temperatures dropping 2–5°C and fog in the Terai. Azamgarh recorded the State’s lowest temperature at 6°C. 9. I won’t become a sadhvi for donations: Harsha Richariya Mahakumbh figure Harsha Richariya said she never wanted to monetise faith and faced sustained backlash from sections of the saint community. She announced plans to resume anchoring alongside religious outreach to remain financially independent, stressing that religion should reflect renunciation, not luxury. 10. stories.title: Speeding car flips twice after tyre burst in Amroha:Two youths from Pilibhit die in accident, including HDFC bank manager and contractual computer operator
stories.summary: On Monday, a speeding out-of-control car jumped into the air when its tire burst in Amroha. Breaking the divider, it flipped twice. Then, sliding 15 feet away, it fell into the other lane. In the accident, two youths from Pilibhit traveling in the car died. One was a manager at HDFC Bank, while the other was a contractual computer operator. As soon as the accident happened, people present on the highway rushed to the car. Both youths were pulled out of the vehicle. One had died on the spot, while the other was critically injured and suffering. Police arrived after being informed of the incident and admitted the injured youth to the hospital, where he breathed his last. According to the police, the car's speed was over 100 kilometers per hour at the time of the accident. The accident occurred near Joya town in Didauli police station area, 5 kilometers away from the district headquarters. In the Haryana village of Didauli police station area, a speeding Beat car met with a terrible accident. Around 12 noon, Kshitij (35) and Shivank Saxena (40), who were traveling in the car, were returning to Pilibhit from Delhi. Suddenly, the car's tire burst. As the vehicle lost balance, it crashed into the divider. According to eyewitnesses, after hitting the divider, the car collided with a street light pole. Then, after flipping twice, it went into the second lane of the highway. The accident was so severe that the car was completely damaged. CCTV footage of the incident has also emerged, which shows the car bouncing in the air. Shivank Saxena from Kayasthan, Pilibhit, died on the spot in the accident. Meanwhile, Kshitij, who was driving the car, was seriously injured. Shivank was the branch manager at HDFC Bank in Pilibhit. Kshitij was working as a contractual computer operator at Puranpur block in Pilibhit. Both friends had gone to Delhi for some work The injured Kshitij was first taken to Joya Community Health Center, where, after primary treatment, seeing his serious condition, the doctors referred him to a higher center. Kshitij died during treatment here. Police investigation has revealed that the car belongs to Shivank. He was driving the car at the time of the accident. He and Kshitij had gone to Delhi for some work. The accident occurred while returning from there. Upon receiving information, Didauli police station reached the spot. The damaged car was removed. The body was sent for a post-mortem. Police are investigating the accident based on CCTV footage. Didauli Station Officer Harish Vardhan Singh said that two young men died in a road accident. The bodies have been kept in the mortuary. After identifying the bodies, the families of the deceased have been informed. Further action will be taken after their arrival.

stories.title: ‘Don’t act like my father,’ Khesari Yadav tells Ravi Kishan:Mimics BJP MP, mocks Pawan Singh, says, 'Gets tipsy after 2 pegs'
stories.summary: The verbal sparring between two superstars of Bhojpuri cinema continues to escalate. Actor Khesari Lal Yadav launched a direct attack on BJP MP from Gorakhpur and fellow actor Ravi Kishan, as well as on Pawan Singh, during a stage event. Khesari not only mimicked Ravi Kishan but also bluntly remarked that Ravi Kishan should not “try to act like my father”. He also took a swipe at Pawan Singh, saying that he “gets drunk after just two pegs”. Addressing an anchor on stage, Khesari said that jokes should be made only with those who can handle them, adding a remark about people with protruding bellies. His supporters claimed this comment was also a veiled taunt aimed at Pawan Singh. See pictures from Kolkata event What's the dispute between Ravi Kishan Khesari? Ravi Kishan and Pawan Singh were present on stage during the Gorakhpur Festival. During the programme, Ravi Kishan took a swipe at Khesari Lal Yadav while addressing the audience. Without naming him directly, Ravi Kishan remarked that there was an actor in the industry who, when he was new, used to show respect by touching both feet, but after gaining fame, had started touching only the knees. Pictures taken from Gorakhpur Festival Don't try to become my father: Khesari to Ravi Kishan In response to the remark, Khesari Lal Yadav recently mimicked Ravi Kishan during an event in Kolkata. Gesturing on stage, he said, “Earlier he used to touch here, now he touches here.” Khesari further remarked, “Be thankful that the person who shows you respect is like a brother. These days, even sons do not touch their father’s feet.” He added, “The man who gave birth to me is my father, Mangru Yadav, and no one should try to become my father.”

stories.summary: Akhilesh Yadav Gears Up for UP 2027: समाजवादी पार्टी के राष्ट्रीय अध्यक्ष एवं उत्तर प्रदेश के पूर्व मुख्यमंत्री अखिलेश यादव ने सन 2027 में होने वाले विधानसभा चुनावों को लेकर अपनी राजनीतिक सक्रियता तेज कर दी है। इसी क्रम में उन्होंने आज कैराना लोकसभा क्षेत्र की सांसद तथा पार्टी के अन्य प्रमुख नेताओं के साथ आगामी विधानसभा चुनावों की रणनीति पर विस्तार से चर्चा की। यह बैठक समाजवादी पार्टी के राज्य मुख्यालय, लखनऊ में आयोजित हुई, जहां क्षेत्रीय चुनावी समीकरणों, संगठन की स्थिति और मौजूदा राजनीतिक परिस्थितियों पर गहन विचार-विमर्श किया गया। बैठक में कैराना लोकसभा क्षेत्र की सांसद इकरा हसन, पूर्व सांसद तबस्सुम हसन सहित कई वरिष्ठ एवं स्थानीय नेता विशेष रूप से मौजूद रहे। चर्चा के दौरान अखिलेश यादव ने लोकसभा क्षेत्र के नेताओं से जमीनी हालात, मतदाता रुझान, सामाजिक समीकरण और संगठनात्मक मजबूती पर विस्तृत जानकारी ली।

stories.title: Bahraich road accident kills 3 youths after car crash:WagonR hits tree on highway, vehicle shatters completely; 2 friends critically injured and hospitalised
stories.summary: A terrible road accident occurred in Bahraich. A WagonR car crashed into a tree. This caused the car to shatter into pieces. Three friends, including the branch manager of a finance company, died on the spot in the accident. Two young men in the car were seriously injured. Police received information from passersby and took all the youths to the hospital. The accident happened around 4 am on Monday near Semarhana village on Nanpara-Lakhimpur Road in the Motipur police station area. 2 pictures of the accident... Abhishek Shukla (25), a resident of the Dhusah area of Balrampur, was a branch manager at Shriram Finance. He, along with his friends Deepu Verma (18), resident of Civil Line, Nitish Singh (19), resident of Alinagar, Ajay Sharma, and Lavkush Sharma, left for Kaichi Dham in Uttarakhand late Sunday evening in his WagonR car (UP 47 U 2214). Car hit tree at 4 AM Monday Around 4 AM on Monday, the car lost control and crashed into a tree on the highway near Semarhana village on the Nanpara-Lakhimpur route. The collision was so severe that the car was completely shattered. The front portion was badly damaged. The car's roof separated from the chassis. All occupants were badly trapped in the car seats. Passersby informed the police Passersby informed the police. Upon this, Motipur station in-charge Anand Chaurasia reached the spot with the police force. Police rescued all people trapped in the car and sent them to Motipur CHC by ambulance. During this, doctors declared Abhishek Shukla, Deepu Verma, and Nitish Singh dead. The injured Ajay Sharma and Lavkush Sharma were sent to the district hospital for treatment. Abhishek's father is retired from bank Abhishek's father, Sadanand Shukla, worked as a clerk in Sarv UP Gramin Bank. Deepu Verma's father, Dinesh, is involved in farming. The third deceased, Nitish's father Manoj, has passed away. Injured Ajay's father has also passed away. He used to manage the restaurant with his brother Balram, while Lovekush works in the timber business. Station in-charge Anand Chaurasia said - The accident happened around 4 am. Three youths died on the spot. The bodies of the deceased have been sent for post-mortem. The family has been informed.

stories.title: Akhilesh targets Satua Baba while hitting out at Yogi:Claims temples demolished, govt misleading people through publicity campaigns
stories.summary: SP chief Akhilesh Yadav hit back at CM Yogi, saying - Some people wake up from sleep but don't come to their senses. Their eyes remain closed all day, and even when awake, they remain intoxicated. He said, "I've heard there are some Satua Baba and Bathua Baba." But the weather is of Bathua. Therefore, we need to be very careful about people who deceive us through ads. They are deceiving us through publicity. Think about where the country has reached and where it should have gone. The country should run on the constitution, and decisions should be made according to the constitution. Former CM Akhilesh was addressing party workers on Republic Day on Monday. He said - Today even Shankaracharya is facing a crisis. Bulldozers are being run on temples that should have been protected. Read the key points of Akhilesh Yadav's address... 1- Crisis emerging for Shankaracharya, bulldozers running over temples Akhilesh Yadav said - Today, temples are being demolished. A crisis is emerging for Shankaracharya. Bulldozers are being run on temples that should have been protected. Aiming Satua Baba, he said that I have heard there is some Satua Baba, some Bathua Baba. It's the season of Bathua. 2- Government can bow down to America anytime They said that one day the Indian government will bow down. Non-veg milk products from America will also come to India. Think what will happen to our saints and sages if this happens? How will they keep their fasts? Our mothers and sisters who observe fasts. 3- Some people remain unconscious even after waking up from sleep SP chief said - Today something amazing happened... I was watching an saying that we are making India self-reliant. This is also being said by a foreign company. Who are they trying to deceive? Some people wake up from sleep but don't come to their senses. Those whose eyes remain closed all day remain intoxicated even after waking up. We need to be very careful of such people. 4- When they started losing, they brought SIR Akhilesh Yadav said - Those who are losing have brought SIR. They are not doing SIR but NRC. Aiming at the Prime Minister's Mann Ki Baat, he said that he was talking about votes. The government is making full efforts to get the votes cancelled. If votes get cancelled, then the question of citizenship will arise. Because every citizen has the right to vote. They are first taking away voting rights, then where will you go? We need to be careful of them. 5- Farmers' situation has gone from bad to worse On the farmers' issue, Akhilesh reminded that the government had promised to double farmers' income, but the situation has gone from bad to worse. Now with the arrival of foreign products and non-veg milk products, cultural and religious traditions could be affected, which will harm sadhus-saints and fasting mothers-sisters. Now know who Satua Baba is? Satua Baba lives at the Satua Baba Peeth in Varanasi. He is the 7th Peethadhishwar and Mahamandaleshwar of the Vishnu Swami sect. He came into discussion during the ongoing Magh Mela in Prayagraj when DM Manish Verma visited his camp ashram and cooked rotis for him. CM Yogi, who came to visit the fair, also visited his ashram. He is also known for his luxury vehicles.

stories.title: Bareilly City Magistrate Alankar Agnihotri resigns:Upset over alleged assault on Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand's disciples
stories.summary: Bareilly City Magistrate Alankar Agnihotri resigned from his post on Republic Day in Uttar Pradesh. He cited the new UGC law and the alleged assault on disciples of Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand as the reasons behind his decision. Agnihotri was seen standing outside his official residence holding a poster that read- 'UGC ROLL BACK – Withdraw the black law. India will not tolerate the insult of Shankaracharya and saints. #BOYCOTT BJP #BOYCOTT BRAHMAN MP MLA…' 5-page resignation letter submitted Alankar Agnihotri also wrote a five-page letter in which he mentioned an incident during the Prayagraj Magh Mela, where disciples of the Shankaracharya were allegedly grabbed by their hair. He wrote that such incidents deeply disturb even an ordinary Brahmin from within. He stated that it appeared the administration and the present government were working against Brahmins and saints, and that their dignity was being undermined. He added that no one was speaking up for the Brahmin community. ‘Is there preparation for genocide of Brahmins?’ asks Agnihotri In his letter, Agnihotri raised a sharp question, asking whether preparations were being made for the genocide of Brahmins. A member of the Brahmin community himself, Alankar Agnihotri became a PCS officer in 2019, securing the 15th rank. Earlier, he had come into the spotlight after placing a photograph of Lord Hanuman in his office. Following this, members of the Bhim Army staged a protest in the collectorate, during which heated arguments were reported with the officer. Senior officials attempt to persuade magistrate In an effort to persuade him, the Additional District Magistrate along with three other officers, reached the City Magistrate’s residence. All four officials stayed for nearly an hour before leaving. No details of the discussions held during the meeting have been disclosed. Political workers and Brahmin groups arrive in support Leaders from several Brahmin organisations, along with workers from the Samajwadi Party and Congress, reached Alankar Agnihotri’s residence to meet him. Brahmin leaders also staged a protest outside his residence, expressing solidarity with the resigned magistrate. Shankaracharya reacts to resignation Reacting to the resignation, Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand said that the respect accorded to Shankaracharyas runs very deep in the hearts of followers of Sanatan Dharma. He added that the consequences of hurting this sentiment could be gauged from this very incident, and the government should assess the outcome carefully.
